Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

cinema — a place where you watch films. Example: I love going to the cinema.
film — a story you watch at the cinema. Example: I like watching films.
music — sounds made with voices or instruments. Example: I love listening to music.
book — pages with text you read. Example: I prefer films to books.
game — an activity with rules you play. Example: I play games with my friends.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I love going to the cinema.
• I prefer films to books.
• I like playing games.
• What do you prefer?
• It is entertaining.
